final_note: You learned how family, friends and culture shape identity.

concepts.def: What you do in a group

walkthroughs.body_html:
Your identity has many layers:

  • Name and family.
  • Where you live.
  • Religion or beliefs.
  • Hobbies and sports.
  • Friends and groups.

Identity grows from:

  • Family — language, food, faith.
  • Friends — fashion, music.
  • School — subjects you love.
  • Culture — country and community.

Self-image = the picture you have of yourself.

It can be helped by:

  • Family praise.
  • Skills you build.
  • Friends who lift you.

And hurt by online comparison. 📱

mcqs.q: What is the difference between reliability and validity in research?
options: Reliable and valid mean the same thing — that the research is good.
Reliable research is published in journals; valid research isn't.
Reliability is whether a method produces consistent results when repeated; validity is whether it actually measures what it claims to. A method can be reliable but invalid, or valid but unreliable.
